machineNote: responder and initiator: pair_responder_step and pair_initiator_step of reference.py, one event at a time ({state, event} -> out). machineTrips: the same over a script, starting from `from`, the state of one result being the state of the next event. because is the cause of a refusal and is what a port tests; a wrong nonce and a wrong static key give the same cause (reveal-mismatch) on purpose, because the commitment cannot tell them apart.
